source_excerpts.text:
# Astra research-method experiment — completed comparison

**No accepted civilisation-level breakthrough or superior research method was established.** All six researchers completed an initial construction and a common warm stress/completion round. Three fresh review contexts checked the scientific outputs. A substantive finite-reference theorem survived internal correctness audits, but much of its surrounding claim was already in Astra. Its remaining originality and practical consequence are unresolved.

The ambition is unchanged: consequential foundational discoveries and new capabilities, across science and engineering. Correct local results remain useful building blocks. They do not substitute for that ambition.

## What was actually tested

| Instruction package | Fresh starts | Final primary outcome |
|---|---|---|
| A: unrestricted competent expert research | Q42, Q63 | No accepted positive |
| B: A plus explicitly start from demonstrated operations and a strong ordinary incumbent, then construct the missing bridge | Q17, Q95 | No accepted positive |
| C: B plus three materially different mechanisms/representations before choosing a construction | Q28, Q54 | No accepted positive; Q28 retains a substantive correctness-checked mathematical lead |

Every arm could already use sources, new representations, counterexamples and alternative mechanisms. A was not handicapped. All received the same mission, compact starting evidence, tools and requested inherited model/settings. Question choice was part of the treatment. No model override, child delegation or sibling exchange was authorized. Initial allowance was up to40 minutes of useful work, followed by the same up-to30-minute warm challenge; this was not hard enforcement of equal computation. Native model-capacity failures interrupted Q63's first round and Q28's second; both resumed in the same context/model after backoff without resetting the allowance. An interrupted review likewise resumed. No failed first outcome was silently discarded.

Three task builders and a design critic were preparatory work, and three reviewers were additional work; they are not experimental outcomes. Before any comparison-trial launch or outcome, 26 October 2026.

The three fixed-task candidates were not admitted. The measurement candidate lacks the required joint gate/specimen instrument; accessible alternatives are closed control problems or lack necessary time traces. The assembly candidate lacks the empirical joint-completion interface, while ordinary bottleneck matching already improves geometry. In the source-grounded thermal task ordinary integral-spline discovery and actual retain-then-reconstruct controls already pass128/128 held-out operations. Preserve this evidence as task-selection findings, not treatment outcomes or new capabilities.

Primary experiment now tests OPPORTUNITY SELECTION AND CONSTRUCTION end-to-end. Six researchers receive the same broad mission, compact known-results/failure packet and tools. A/B/C instruction packages remain ARMS.json, with two fresh starts each. The scientific question selected is part of the treatment. There is one shared mission family, not six independent scientific problem comparisons. No statistical breakthrough-rate or globally best method claim follows.

Target: an original consequential scientific operation or broad foundational principle, with a completed checked construction and strong pre-existing comparison. The positive/negative/unresolved rules in PLAN.txt remain. Small benchmark gains, routine new constants, unsupported novelty and assumed critical primitives cannot win. Baseline is unrestricted. Fixed-task scientific trials are neither launched nor counted.

Initial useful-work allowance is up to40minutes, common warm stress-and-completion allowance up to30minutes. Same allowances/access/inherited model settings; actual work may differ, with no equal-compute claim. All six first starts run in one block, no nested workers. Initial scientific artifacts are preserved before common continuation. Reviewer gets neutral candidate IDs, original question, substantive pivots, sources, proofs and code, without prompts/treatment labels. Use ordinary scientific notes and public tool/action traces, never private chain-of-thought. A narrower replacement question must meet the same consequence gate in its own right.
